data.BRIEF_FACTS:
IN THE COURT OF THE HON’BLE, I ADDL. JUNIOR CIVIL JUDGE-CUM-V ADDL. METROPOLITAN MAGISTRATE, MEDCHAL MALKAJGIRI DIST. UPPAL AT L.B NAGAR
Honoured sir,
Facts of the case are that i.e., on 01.01.2024 at 13.00 hrs received a complaint from Sri B.Kumaraswamy, SI of Police PS Nacharam in which he stated that on 01.01.2024 at 10:30hrs while he was conducting vehicle checking along with staff K.Laxmaiah PC 3638 , PC Rahul Aditya PC 10719 and Prabhakar HG 1570 at Nacharam X Road, then one person is going on walk towards Nacharam in suspicious manner meanwhile when he saw them he tried to flee away, but they apprehended him and enquired the reason of his fleeing ,he revealed his name as Lonka Harish S/o Somaiah, age: 20 years, occ :CCTV Work, caste: BC-Chaakali, R/o Janapriya Apartments, Annapurna colony, Mallapur and  also stated that he was carrying Ganja on his pocket. Immediately he followed the guidelines and also informed the same to superior officers. As such he served notice  U/s 50 of NDPS Act -1985 on the accused person under proper acknowledgement also informed him about the Right to Search before the Gazetted officer/Magistrate. Later a requisition was sent to the Gazetted officer Manamadha Rao Detective Inspector  Of Uppal PS and subsequently secured two mediators to act as panchas. he served a notice to Panchas to stand as panchas for search seizure and confession of the accused person for which they agree for the same as well as brought weighing machine to the spot with the help of Prabhaka HG 1570,  after arrival of Gazeetted officer on consent of the accused  recorded detailed confessional statement cum seizure Panchanama of him in presence of Panchas.  During interrogation he voluntarily confessed that he had a habit of consuming ganja, for which on 31.12.2023 at afternoon hours he went to Dhoolpet and purchased Ganja of 50 grams from unknown persons for an amount of Rs 2000/- . On searching him found dry leaves with obnoxious smell appeared to be ganja on his pocket and on weighing found it to be 50 grams of ganja, the same is seized in the presence of mediators duly affixing the sign chits. Thereafter he brought the accused Harish along with the seized property and submitting a written report before the SHO to take necessary legal action.  Encl 1) confessional cum seizure Panchanama 2) Seized material as per Panchanama 3)Notice served to the accused U/s 50 Cr.PC 4) Requisition letter to Gazetted officer and 5)Notices to Panchas.
Received on 01.01.2024 at 13:00hrs
Basing on the contents of the above complaint, I M Prabhakar Reddy INSP of Police have registered a case in Cr No. 02/2024 U/s 8( c) r/w 20(b)(ii)(A) NDPS Act and took up the investigation.
